title: Anaphylaxis personal action card
category: Medical and first · Aid · Disaster · Health
summary: Medical-heavy survival entry for keeping personal allergy plans, epinephrine location, and emergency contacts together.
warnings: Escalate urgently if you see: throat swelling, wheeze, faintness, hives with breathing trouble, repeated vomiting, or known severe allergy.
failure_signs: Red flags appear: throat swelling, wheeze, faintness, hives with breathing trouble, repeated vomiting, or known severe allergy
